basic_info.description: Experience elevated city living in this luxurious south-facing 1BR/1BA residence at LUMINA. This light-filled home boasts city views and an open-concept layout that seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas. The modern kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line finishes, including SieMatic cabinetry, Caesarstone quartz countertops and backsplash, and premium Gaggenau and Bosch appliances. Additional highlights include wide-plank hardwood floors, an XL walk-in closet, an in-unit washer/dryer, and ample storage throughout. The elegant bathroom is outfitted with European porcelain tiles, a Maax soaking tub, and Kohler fixtures. Designed by Bernardo Fort-Brescia of Arquitectonica, LUMINA offers unparalleled amenities: a full-length saline lap pool, 7,000 sq. ft. fitness center, landscaped rooftop terrace, valet parking, 24-hour door and front desk service, and more. Residents enjoy on-site access to Woodlands Market, a neighborhood favorite for organic groceries, gourmet prepared foods, and a cozy coffee bar. Ideally located just steps from the Embarcadero, Ferry Building, South Beach Marina, Financial District, Oracle Park, Chase Center, and some of San Francisco's best dining and entertainment.
